name: PreQ1 type II riboswitch bound to 7-deazaguanine analog
preparationNotes: Single chain A. SO4 crystallization ions (A:101-104) removed. PRF ligand at A:34. Box 22x22x22 A. Actives/decoys reused from 4RZD PreQ1 type I for direct cross-fold comparison.
source: RCSB PDB 3Q50; Kang M et al. Nat Chem Biol 2009 doi:10.1038/nchembio.254
affinitySource: Kang et al. 2009; Kd ~1 uM for preQ1
affinityNotes: PreQ1 type II (H-type pseudoknot) vs type I (aptamer fold in 4RZD). Same metabolite, completely different RNA architecture. Enables fold-dependent scoring comparison for preQ1 analogs.
notes: PreQ1 type II riboswitch, 2.75 A X-ray. H-type pseudoknot fold. Companion to 4RZD (type I aptamer fold).
